commands.name: todo.toggle
commands.description: Flip the done flag of one todo.

commands.name: todo.update
commands.description: Replace the text of one todo.

commands.name: todo.remove
commands.description: Delete one todo. The host keeps a 5 s undo buffer for the built-in card only.

commands.name: media.playpause
commands.description: Toggle play/pause on the current SMTC session.

commands.name: app.openUrl
commands.description: Open an https URL in the default browser. http and custom schemes are rejected.

commands.name: app.notify
commands.description: Show a Windows toast. The host prefixes the widget name.

commands.name: panel.toggle
commands.description: Hide the rail. Show it again with the hotkey.

commands.name: data.refresh
commands.description: Ask the host to re-sample the providers this widget declared.
